messages:
Alicia (CS): Heads-up — NovusFleet showing a steady QPS climb and two new teams started integration tests today. Looks like a multi-product ramp.
Priya (NovusFleet): Yep, SRE and Search teams spun up feature branches and started hitting the API this morning. We also kicked off heavier batch embed jobs.
Ben (Solutions): Nice — can you share approximate QPS, embeds/min, and any latency changes?
Priya (NovusFleet): Quick numbers: avg gen QPS was ~12, spiked to ~45 sustained over last 2 hours. Embeds jobs ~15/min. 95p gen latency moved from ~220ms -> ~380ms on hosted; no errors so far.
Alicia (CS): That's a clear expansion signal. Recommend we propose a Dedicated pilot + enablement workshop. Also flag renewal upsell — their annual renewal window is next quarter.
Ben (Solutions): Agree. At 45 QPS sustained we'd likely cross our Dedicated thresholds. Need the traffic curve and peak estimates to size a pool. Priya, can you export 24h usage?
Priya (NovusFleet): Working on it now.
usage-bot: weekly-usage-report.pdf uploaded by Priya (NovusFleet)
Priya (NovusFleet): Paste of Prom query I'm running:
```
sum(rate(redwood_requests_total{org="novusfleet"}[5m])) by (route)
```
Ben (Solutions): Perfect. If you can attach the last 24h timeseries I'll size a Dedicated pool and show cost delta vs hosted. Also propose a 60m enablement session: onboarding, routing policies, cache hints, fallback strategies.
Alicia (CS): I'll add a renewal uplift recommendation to the account plan and draft a cross-team enablement playbook. ETA: draft by EOD tomorrow.
Ethan (Ops): From infra: we can pre-provision a Reserved pool for a short test window. Need proposed commit window and expected peak so autoscale rules don't prematurely spin down.
Priya (NovusFleet): We expect a peak ~70 QPS during a load test tomorrow 10:00–12:00 PST. Initial canary: 2 GPU nodes should be fine.
Ben (Solutions): Noted. I'll draft a runbook (canary config, KV cache warmup, batching suggestions, quantization options) and a prompt-level eval checklist.
Alicia (CS): Action items:
- Priya: export 24h usage + confirm test window (assigned)
- Ben: Dedicated sizing + canary runbook (assigned)
- Ethan: pre-provision reserved pool tomorrow 08:00 PST (assigned)
- Alicia: update renewal playbook + coordinate enablement session (assigned)
Priya (NovusFleet): Thanks — we'll upload logs and invite the SRE leads to the enablement session. Channel: #novusfleet-onboarding.
Ben (Solutions): Great. @Priya we'll also need a sample prompt set for quality/regression checks. :thumbsup: 
Alicia (CS): Marking this as High expansion signal in the account tracker. I'll follow up after the workshop. :rocket:
